page.layout: One page of text in a single column on the right of the scan. The left side is blank paper. Running head at the top, then the page's text: a continuing paragraph, a decorated chapter head with title and "Pars IIII.", an italic subtitle, and a paragraph opening with a woodcut initial. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: modestiae ac verecundiae fines transgre-diamur. Quòd enim ad praecepta attiner, non seorsim hîc & sigillatim de iis agere necessarium ducimus, cùm quae in expostulationum & querelarum obseruanda esse respõsionibus, ostendimus, etiam hîc sint adhibeda. Itaq; his missis ad aliud, & postremū epistolarū genus aggrediemur.
main_text.head: DE RATIONE CONTEXEN-DARUM EPI-STOLARUM Pars IIII.

head.i: Familiaris, seu extraordinarii generis, & primò Nunciatorias Epistolas continens.

main_text.p: ABSOLVTIS iis epistolis, quae ad tria causarum pertinent genera, reliquum adhuc quartum & postremum est genus fami-liare,

page.notes: The initial A is a woodcut letter, joined to the small capitals "BSOLVTIS". The subtitle is set in italic and centred. The "j" at the end of "extraordinarij" is read as the vowel i. The head's number "IIII" is read as caput 4.
